title: Cam Jordan: I'm not asking for top dollar, I'm asking to be valued

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cam Jordan: I'm not asking for top dollar, I'm asking to be valued
sources.description: Defensive end Cam Jordan has spent his entire 15-year NFL career with the Saints and he's the franchise's all-time leader in games played, but he may not be back for a 16th season in New Orleans.
